notes: The catalog text contains no Certificate of Achievement section for Media Arts: Editing and Color Grading; the only section for this program is the Associate of Arts Degree (State Code 45257). This record reads that AA section because its courses match the closed list exactly and its 24 major units fall in the certificate's 16-30 unit range. A reviewer should confirm the certificate's own requirements elsewhere in the catalog (e.g., the Cinema section or certificate listings).
degree_total of 60 is the AA's printed 'Total Minimum Units: 60' and applies to the degree, not the certificate; no general education pattern is named on the page.

The required-course heading says '5 REQUIRED COURSES' but six courses are listed under it (CINEMA 105, CINEMA 107, MEDIART 100, MEDIART 116, MEDIART 121, MEDIART 122); six x 3 + 3 + 3 = 24 matches 'Major Units: 24', so all six were recorded as required.
Outcomes are the Program Student Learning Outcomes printed for the AA degree; outcome 3 is printed without a final period.
No careers are named in the program description; the outcomes mention 'gainful employment in the entertainment industry' only as an outcome.
